name: to-spec
description: Synthesize settled work into a GitHub specification without restarting discovery.
adaptations: Use the active GitHub repository directly and remove tracker/setup indirection.
Do not require triage labels when publishing specifications.
Publish through connected GitHub write capabilities when available; otherwise return the complete unpublished specification in chat.
Treat settled discussion as authoritative and ask at most one focused question only when the highest existing behavioral test seam still needs confirmation.
